type: Integrated predictor-guided airfoil search and parametric 3D geometry generator
shape_relationship: The newly generated 2D airfoil's exact CST coefficients are used at every span station, with local chord scaling, sweep, twist and dihedral. The 2D top view uses leading/trailing edges from the exported 3D mesh.
outputs: OBJ and indexed mesh in metres
Conditions, predictions, shape provenance and geometry checks
limitations: Existing conflicting labels and weak drag prediction remain
Search results may have no predicted target match
No structural, material, mass or flight model
Example dimensions are editable and are not approved project requirements
